mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.name, e.lifecycle_status, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.place, e.event_type, f.completion_notice, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = e.space_id AND a.event_id = e.id AND a.participant_id = #{participantId} AND a.status = 'SUBMITTED') AS submitted FROM events e LEFT JOIN forms f ON f.space_id = e.space_id AND f.event_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.space_id = #{spaceId}

SELECT (SELECT max(l.seq) FROM checkin_logs l WHERE l.space_id = #{spaceId} AND l.event_id = #{eventId} AND l.participant_id = #{participantId}) AS check_in, (SELECT max(a.revision) FROM applications a WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.participant_id = #{participantId}) AS application
